It is led by the CVGA (Central Victorian Greenhouse Alliance). The program's planning stage was run on behalf of 43 regional councils, 11 metropolitan councils, several greenhouse alliances and the Electric Vehicle Council, with funding from Victoria's environment department (DELWP).\n- **The network:** In Stage 2b, the implementation stage that ran from 2022 to 2024, the program installed 23 fast-charging stations from Whittlesea to Mildura to fill gaps in regional charging.\n- **App and operator:** Evie Networks was contracted to operate and maintain the chargers. An old Tesla Motors Club thread on the CTR network says that the sites were free at the time, according to the Evie app. One of the early sites listed there was in Sale.\n- **Council chargers outside CTR:** Wellington Shire (Gippsland) said its planning drew on the Charging the Regions study. Its council-owned chargers charged 40c/kWh, paid through either the Evie or Chargefox app, depending on the location. That page is about 4 years old, so the price may have changed.\n- **Other apps that may help:** Across Victoria, Chargefox and Evie are the main fast-charging providers.
